name: Hello
author: brodgar
description: Example addon — runs in the Lua sandbox (self-checks it at OnLoad) and demonstrates the event bus, timers, saved variables (hafen.store), custom UI (hafen.ui — a draggable window, a HUD overlay, and world-space gob overlays, all drawn via the GOut wrapper), widget-creation interception (hafen.ui.onWidgetCreate — observes every server window the client builds and logs its {id,type,place,caption,parentType} descriptor, the foundation for replacing native UI), global hotkeys (hafen.key.bind — Ctrl+H toggles the window + an unbound 'ping', both shown under a 'Hello' section in Options > Keybindings), input hooks (hafen.hook.input — a MapView mousedown pre-hook that cancels map clicks while 'map-lock' is on), action hooks (hafen.hook.action — a MapView 'click' pre-hook that intercepts a move and re-sends it while 'move-intercept' is on), message hooks (hafen.hook.message — an IMeter 'set' pre-hook that swallows meter updates so the vitals bars freeze while 'vitals-freeze' is on), and the read API (hafen.gob.*, hafen.world.*, hafen.map.*, hafen.player.* incl. vitals, hafen.time.*, hafen.sound.*, hafen.items.*, hafen.char.* incl. food/skills, hafen.party.*, hafen.buffs.*, hafen.study.*, hafen.actionbar.*) plus the widget-tree events (VitalsChanged, BuffAdded/Removed/Changed, FepChanged, StudyChanged, ActionbarChanged, EquipChanged).
